name: Mutualistic Saudade
source:
348  days // 10 hours // 27 minutes

That's how long Hazel Hathaway of the American Union[AU] had been aboard the Orbital Space Station[OSS] when the nuclear war came to an end.

But this isn't a story about all that.

This is the story of what came after.

Of the last two survivors: a Beta and an Omega, living out their last days in each others company.
